name: MuST-C: Multilingual Speech-to-Text Translation Corpus
description: MuST-C is a multilingual speech-to-text translation corpus consisting of English TED Talks aligned with translations into 8 European languages (German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian). Created by Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) and presented at NAACL-HLT 2019, it includes hundreds of hours of aligned audio per language pair.
